senses.gloss: m. (נָשַׂג) reaching, ה׳ יד regard to one’s wealth, the law regulating the payment of certain vows according to one’s means (Lev. XXVII, 8).
units: <cite ref="Arakhin 5a:33">Arakh. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>נידין בה׳ יד</he> does he come under the law of &c.?—
Ib. IV, 1 ה׳ יד בנודר the law of hesseg yad is regulated by the means of him who makes the vow; a. e.
